# Rules and Procedure

To start the supported operation, open the procedure page from the product and module indexes. Complete these steps: (1) choose the declared source, (2) run the documented operation, and (3) check the resulting page and source link.

The key parameter is `--source`; use the declared source identifier and do not substitute an undocumented product. If an input fails, stop the operation, check the source identifier and return to the procedure page before retrying. These rules describe the operating boundary for the current sample.
